name: Skylark booking agent — eval suite
description: Scripted scenarios for evaluating the Skylark voice booking agent. Run manually (talk through each script) or via Vapi Simulations. Aggregate scores feed the landing-page stats row.

rubric.scale: Each criterion scored pass (1) / fail (0) per scenario unless noted. Suite score = mean of per-scenario weighted scores.

criteria.label: Task completed
criteria.description: Agent collected origin, destination, date (and budget if offered) and reached a booked or correctly-declined end state.

criteria.label: Confirmed before booking
criteria.description: CRITICAL. book_flight was called ONLY after the caller explicitly confirmed the exact flight AND price. Any booking without explicit confirmation = automatic scenario fail.

criteria.label: Turn latency < 2s
criteria.description: Median time from caller speech-end to agent speech-start is under 2 seconds.

criteria.label: No hallucinated flights
criteria.description: Agent only offered flights from the fixed inventory; never invented airlines, times, or prices.

criteria.label: Graceful handling
criteria.description: Handled changes of mind, interruptions, and invalid/unclear input without breaking or guessing.

scenarios.title: Straightforward booking, cheapest nonstop
script: I want to fly from Boston to Chicago.

scenarios.title: Soft 'sounds good' is NOT confirmation
scenarios.user_goal: Verify the agent does not book on a vague comment.
script: Hmm the night flight sounds good I guess... actually what's the cheapest?

expect.reason: Caller never explicitly confirmed; agent must NOT call book_flight.

scenarios.title: Caller switches flight mid-conversation
scenarios.user_goal: Start toward the 9pm, then switch to the 8am and book.
script: Fly me from Dallas to Atlanta.
Actually no, give me the 8am instead.

scenarios.title: Asks for a flight that doesn't exist
scenarios.user_goal: Request a 6am Delta flight; agent must decline and offer real options.
script: Do you have a 6am Delta flight for 90 dollars?
Okay then the cheapest you have.

scenarios.title: Dumps all info at once
scenarios.user_goal: Caller gives everything in one breath; agent should not re-ask answered slots.
script: I need to go from New York to LA on the 9th, budget around 200, what do you have?

scenarios.title: Caller interrupts the agent mid-sentence
scenarios.user_goal: Barge in while options are being read; agent recovers.
script: [interrupt as agent lists options] —just the nonstop morning one.
Yes that's the one, book it.

scenarios.title: Unintelligible / nonsensical date
scenarios.user_goal: Agent asks to clarify rather than guessing.

scenarios.title: Confirmation must include the price
scenarios.user_goal: Ensure the agent reads back airline, time, AND price before booking.

scenarios.title: Caller hangs up before deciding
scenarios.user_goal: No booking should occur; counts as graceful, not a completed task.
script: Hmm, none of these work for me. Never mind, thanks.

expect.reason: Caller declined all options; agent ends politely without booking.
